PT001 PD-L1/CTLA-4 recombinant protein therapeutic vaccine for stage II-III canine oral malignant melanoma Protect Animal Health (寶泰生醫) multicenter field trial · Taiwan Recruiting — multicenter field trial What is being offered: Official sponsor recruitment notice dated 2025-10-26 remains publicly listed; sponsor subsequently announced regulatory approval to conduct the Taiwan field trial on 2025-11-03 and continues to describe PT001 as an active oncology development program in 2026. Multicenter randomized open-label two-arm field trial of PT001, a PD-L1 and CTLA-4 recombinant-protein therapeutic vaccine, for confirmed stage II-III canine oral malignant melanoma. Age >=1 year. Owners must agree to suspend other cancer treatment. Excludes severe liver/kidney disease, autoimmune disease, bone-marrow disease or other high-risk systemic disease, dogs requiring steroids/immunosuppressants, and prior radiation. Tumor must be recordable/measurable. Trial contains a control arm. Final screening by study site is required.
